en.title: BlockNest Tips: High Score and Combo Guide | Exclusive LLM
en.description: Tips for a higher BlockNest score: keep the 10×10 board open, build a x5 combo, plan your pieces and avoid common mistakes.
en.h1: BlockNest tips: a guide to higher scores
en.lead: Keep the roomy 10×10 board open and keep your combo alive.
en.intro: In BlockNest most of your score comes not from single lines but from back-to-back clears and from clearing several lines in one move. This guide shows how to keep the board tidy, how to carry the combo multiplier up to x5 and how to avoid the mistakes that end a game early.

items: Place pieces along the edges and corners first; leave the middle free for big pieces.
Avoid single-cell holes: only a 1×1 piece can fill them.
Always keep at least one 3×3 area open so a big square never traps you.
Keep one row or column clear for long bars (1×5).
Clearing lines move after move raises the combo multiplier up to x5.
Instead of closing a line right away, set up a layout that lets you clear again on the next move.
Think about all three tray pieces together: which order clears the most lines?
Clearing two or three lines in one move scores far more than single lines.
Filling the middle of the board too early.
Looking only at the piece in hand and forgetting the other two.
Overfilling the board for a combo; once you are stuck, the combo ends too.
Rushing: BlockNest has no timer, so think every move through.
Undo a wrong move with an optional ad.
When a game ends, you may get the chance to continue with an optional ad.
18 achievement badges give you small goals to sharpen your play.

en.description: A strategy guide for Woodora Classic: plan blocks that cannot rotate, use the clear preview, earn streak bonuses and keep the 8×8 board open.

en.lead: Blocks don't rotate, so the player who plans ahead wins.
en.intro: In Woodora Classic blocks cannot rotate and the 8×8 board fills up fast. The key to a good score is thinking about all three blocks together and leaving room for every shape. Scoring rewards this too: 10 points per square and 100 per line, with bonuses for multiple lines and consecutive clears.

items: New blocks only arrive once you place all three, so place the hardest shape first.
Before placing a block, make sure the other two will still fit.
Blocks don't rotate, so keep separate space for horizontal and vertical bars.
Saving corners for L-shaped blocks often pays off.
Before you drop a block, the game shows how many lines will clear; use it to find the best spot.
Clearing two lines in one move is usually better than one.
Consecutive clears earn streak bonuses; aim to clear at least one line every set.
Tap-to-place can be easier than dragging for precise placements.
Focus on finishing lines; many half-filled lines lock the board.
Avoid single-cell holes.
Keep a wide area open in the middle; it helps when a 3×3 square arrives.
You can undo your last move once per game with an optional ad.

en.description: Tips for all four games in Block Four: high scores in Block Route, speed in Falling Blocks, reaching 2048 and beating Color Sort levels.
en.h1: Block Four tips: a guide to all four games
en.lead: Every game has its own strategy; here is what works best.
en.intro: Block Four brings four different puzzles together in one app: Block Route, Falling Blocks, Number Merge (2048) and Color Sort. Their rules differ, so the best tactics differ too. In this guide you will find short, practical tips for each game.

items: In Classic mode, take your time; there is no timer.
In 120 Seconds, don't hunt for the perfect spot: quick, safe placements score more.
Daily Route gives you 30 moves; try to make every move clear a line.
Clearing several lines at once earns combos and big bonuses.
Keep the surface flat; deep wells and spikes make the game harder.
Leave one column empty for long pieces and clear several lines together.
Hard drop saves time, but use it only when you are sure of the placement.
Move and resize the on-screen buttons to fit your hand, and pick a left- or right-handed layout.
Keep your biggest tile in one corner and never move it out.
Swipe mostly in two directions; use the fourth only when you must.
Keep the row next to your biggest tile full to protect the corner.
You get 3 free undos per game; save them for critical moments.
Before your first move, look at every tube and find the easiest color to collect.
An empty tube is your most valuable resource; don't fill it right away.
Completing one tube with a single color frees up space in the others.
If you get stuck, undo or restart the level.

es.title: Consejos de Block Four: bloques, 2048 y colores | Exclusive LLM
es.description: Consejos para los cuatro juegos de Block Four: récords en Ruta de bloques, velocidad en Bloques en caída, llegar a 2048 y superar Ordenar colores.
es.h1: Consejos de Block Four: guía de los cuatro juegos
es.lead: Cada juego tiene su propia estrategia; esto es lo que mejor funciona.
es.intro: Block Four reúne cuatro puzzles distintos en una sola app: Ruta de bloques, Bloques en caída, Fusionar números (2048) y Ordenar colores. Sus reglas son diferentes, así que las mejores tácticas también lo son. En esta guía encontrarás consejos breves y prácticos para cada juego.

items: En el modo Clásico, tómate tu tiempo; no hay reloj.
En 120 segundos, no busques el sitio perfecto: las colocaciones rápidas y seguras suman más puntos.
Ruta diaria te da 30 movimientos; intenta que cada movimiento elimine una línea.
Eliminar varias líneas a la vez da combos y grandes bonus.
Mantén la superficie plana; los pozos profundos y los picos complican la partida.
Deja una columna vacía para las piezas largas y elimina varias líneas a la vez.
La caída rápida ahorra tiempo, pero úsala solo cuando estés seguro de la posición.
Mueve los botones en pantalla y cambia su tamaño para adaptarlos a tu mano, y elige una disposición para diestros o zurdos.
Mantén tu ficha más grande en una esquina y no la saques nunca de ahí.
Desliza sobre todo en dos direcciones; usa la cuarta solo cuando no quede otra.
Mantén llena la fila junto a tu ficha más grande para proteger la esquina.
Tienes 3 movimientos para deshacer gratis por partida; guárdalos para los momentos críticos.
Antes del primer movimiento, mira todos los tubos y busca el color más fácil de reunir.
Un tubo vacío es tu recurso más valioso; no lo llenes enseguida.
Completar un tubo con un solo color libera espacio en los demás.
Si te atascas, deshaz o reinicia el nivel.
